name: Should I replace my kitchen flooring before or after installing new cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace my kitchen flooring before or after installing new cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, it is advisable to install new kitchen flooring before new cabinets are placed. This approach ensures a continuous, seamless look, provides a stable, level surface for cabinet installation, and prevents potential damage to finished flooring during heavy cabinet work. An exception might be if you opt for a floating floor system where cabinets should not sit directly on top, requiring a precise cut around the cabinet footprint. AKN Design Group's project managers guide these sequencing decisions to optimize both aesthetics and structural integrity for your customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: It is generally best to install kitchen flooring before new cabinets for a seamless look and stable surface, though exceptions exist. We advise on sequencing for optimal results.
